flags.why: Calling someone bư disparages their intelligence and needs a derogatory warning ([dictionary](https://vtudien.com/viet-viet/dictionary/nghia-cua-tu-b%C6%B0)).
In đồ ăn nhẹ, đồ ăn means food and nhẹ means light; ăn nhẹ itself is not a noun meaning a snack.
flags.fix: Remove sense 2; retain the verb sense.

flags.why: Măm is baby talk for eating, not an exclamation meaning that food tastes good ([dictionary](https://vi.wiktionary.org/wiki/m%C4%83m)).
Kháu means cute or pretty, not precious in the sense of a valuable possession ([dictionary](https://vtudien.com/viet-viet/dictionary/nghia-cua-tu-kh%C3%A1u)).
